decision.promotion: Do not promote the conditional candidate as superior: fixed confirmation tied baseline and did not exercise rescue. Retain development regression fix as experimental; cache and certified invocation remain independently tested runtime techniques.
decision.continuation: This bounded series is complete. No more maps are appended to force a pass. Any further combat optimization requires a new preregistered hypothesis and fresh evaluation set; global best was not established.

limitations: 56 completed model games are repeated paired trials, not 56 independent environments.

One interrupted Laya episode had five successful calls before user admission; its raw data remains unscored and all calls count in totals. The missing episode was replaced in a separate append-only segment, without rerunning seven completed games.
Actual certified skips make no model request and have application provenance; never count them as model judgments.
All episodes are synchronous simulations against fixed rule attack; this is not optimized-model head-to-head or realtime quality evidence.
CPU caching is build-scoped and tested for exact score/action parity. Timings during overlapping user workloads are not isolated speed benchmarks.
Stronger global anti-cycle policies increased deaths in held-out games and were rejected. Fixed fixtures alone would have missed this.
